Unit: S2 date x 150 m CDL-homogeneous cluster in the 10 km box; the preset field is excluded from training.

Ablation: adds EVI, NBR2, red/NIR/SWIR1/SWIR2 reflectance and days since last obs. Not used for the calendar because backend/field's field series stores only NDVI/NDWI/BSI medians.

Diagnostic ablation without DOY sin/cos and 7-day Tmax (seasonal proxies). Because the labels are built from calendar windows, a model can score well by learning the calendar; this shows how much of the score is spectral. Not used for the calendar or the checks.

items.labels: none (unsupervised); checked against Jul-Aug 2021/2022 drought and Sept 2022 heat wave (U dates)
items.notes: Reduced B6.2: only Sentinel-2/Landsat NDVI (field vs its own same-week history, leave-one-year-out) and POWER Tmax / Hargreaves ETo anomalies. Blocked: ECOSTRESS LST, ESI, SMAP, IMERG, OpenET, MODIS (Earthdata / OpenET keys). Tmax and Hargreaves ETo are strongly correlated, so 'two components > 1' is mostly a heat rule. The isolation forest is two-sided (cool/green weeks can be outliers); see cool_week_flags.
